items.raw_excerpt: Este martesl, la selección chilena vivió nueva jornada de entrenamiento en el Complejo Deportivo Quilín de cara a su gira por Norteamérica.
items.summary_en: Chile's national soccer team held another training session on Tuesday at the Quilin sports complex. The team is getting ready for its tour of North America.

items.raw_excerpt: Multiple spells of heavy rain lashed Bengaluru on Tuesday evening, leaving several parts of the city waterlogged and bringing traffic to a crawl, with office-goers struggling to get home.
items.summary_en: Heavy rain hit Bengaluru on Tuesday evening. Several areas were flooded and traffic slowed to a crawl. Office workers struggled to get home.
items.summary_ko: 화요일 저녁 벵갈루루에 폭우가 쏟아졌다. 여러 지역이 물에 잠기면서 교통이 거의 멈춰 섰고, 퇴근길 직장인들이 집으로 돌아가는 데 어려움을 겪었다.
items.title_en: Heavy rain slows traffic across Bengaluru
items.title_original: Heavy rain paralyses traffic in several parts of Bengaluru

items.raw_excerpt: [AUDIO] ¿Qué tan grave es la lesión de Zampedri?
items.summary_en: Zampedri did not suffer a serious injury in the match against Palestino. The news brings relief to Universidad Catolica fans. He should be available for the next games.

items.summary_en: This article tells two stories from Helsinki' s past. It looks at small chapters of the Finnish capital' s history. The pieces make old local events easy to understand.

items.raw_excerpt: Fancy some extra sick days for when your kids pick up a daycare bug? Or an on-site nanny to let you bring your kids to work with you?
items.summary_en: New Zealand workplaces are adding new benefits to help parents. Some let staff take more sick days when a child picks up a daycare bug. Others hire an on-site nanny so employees can bring kids to work.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 직장들이 육아를 돕는 새 복지를 늘리고 있다. 아이가 어린이집에서 병을 얻어오면 병가를 더 쓸 수 있게 하는 곳도 있다. 따로 보모를 고용해 직장에 아이를 데려오게 하는 기업도 있다.
items.title_en: Extra sick days, childcare help: New perks NZ staff are getting

items.raw_excerpt: There are many ways to explore Lisbon, but one of my favourite walks is right through the heart of the city, starting at Rossio and making your way down towards the river.
items.summary_en: A favorite walk through Lisbon starts at Rossio square and heads down toward the river. The route passes the old streets and lively center of the city. It is a pleasant way to see the city on foot.

items.title_en: Walking through the heart of Lisbon

items.raw_excerpt: Free kick or mark, the call that helped Norwood to a SANFL grand final victory has been contentious for 48 years, but the eastern suburbs rivals are about to set the record straight.
items.summary_en: The referee call that helped Norwood win the 1978 SANFL grand final has been argued about for 48 years. The two clubs from Adelaide's eastern suburbs meet again in this year's grand final. The old dispute is back in the spotlight.
items.summary_ko: 1978년 샌플 결승전에서 노우드의 우승을 도왔던 심판 판정은 48년 동안 논란이 되어 왔습니다. 애들레이드 동부 교외의 두 라이벌 팀이 올해 결승전에서 다시 만나면서 그 옛 논란이 다시 주목을 받고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Sturt and Norwood revive a 48-year-old grand final argument
items.title_ko: 스터트와 노우드가 48년 전 결승전 판정 논란을 다시 꺼냈다
items.title_original: Sturt versus Norwood stirs up 1978 controversy ahead of SANFL final
